Tiers: Learn, Guides, Migrate, Reference; it spreads REFERENCE_GROUPS from docs/src/reference-nav.generated.ts (docs/scripts/gen-reference.ts, from each manifest) and TROUBLESHOOTING_GROUPS from docs/src/troubleshooting-nav.generated.ts (docs/scripts/gen-troubleshooting.ts, from anti-patterns.md). Routes: docs/src/routes/docs/[...slug].tsx serves every file under docs/src/content/docs at /docs/ plus the file path without its .md extension; index.md is /docs. duplicates.note: a11y.md documents the @pyreon/a11y package (announce, LiveRegion, VisuallyHidden, SkipLink, createA11yId, route announcements). accessibility.md is the framework-wide map (form ARIA wiring, focus traps, reduced motion, ARIA serialization, primitives). Keep a11y.md as the product overview and retitle accessibility.md "Accessibility in Pyreon" under Guides; cross-link both.
quickstart.md scaffolds with npm create; getting-started.md installs into an existing Vite project. Retitle getting-started.md "Add Pyreon to an existing project" so the two read as different paths.
Reference (441 lines), pattern (224) and how-to guide (70). Merge the pattern page into the guide; keep island-architecture.md as the reference under Zero.
Both teach useQuery + useMutation. Merge into the guide.
Both compare store, state-tree and signals. Merge.
Both cover styled + PyreonUI theming. Merge; the guide is also the stand-in Design System overview.
The guide covers fields and arrays; the two pattern pages repeat parts of it. Fold them in as sections.
Router setup is a subset of the routing guide.
ssr.md and ssg.md are references; the guide helps choose a mode. Keep, cross-link.

The Validation product is @pyreon/validate (validate.md, titled "Validate"), while the page titled "Validation" documents @pyreon/validation, the Zod / Valibot / ArkType adapter gate. Readers following "Validation" land on the wrong package. Retitle validation.md "Validation adapters".
Same record as the marketing /benchmarks page; one should be canonical.
Reactivity Lens shows static live/static hints; LPIH shows runtime counts. Similar names, different features: worth one sentence on each page pointing at the other.

gaps.note: No Design System overview page. Eleven package pages exist (ui-core, styler, unistyle, rocketstyle, attrs, elements, coolgrid, kinetic, kinetic-presets, document-primitives, connector-document); the sidebar points the product at guides/styling-theming.md until an overview lands.
No single Editors overview: the product spans rich-text.md (@pyreon/rich-text) and code.md (@pyreon/code). The sidebar lists both; an overview that introduces the pair is missing.
No Tooling overview: the product spans cli.md (doctor, check), lint.md, devtools.md, reactivity-lens.md and lpih.md. @pyreon/testing has no guide page at all, only the generated reference/testing.md.

No Migrate overview: the product spans the five compat pages (react-compat.md, preact-compat.md, vue-compat.md, solid-compat.md, svelte-compat.md) and the migrating-from-*.md guides. migrating-from-react.md is the closest entry point.
mcp.md is titled "@pyreon/mcp" and is the API page; it serves as the overview, but there is no AI-workflow overview tying MCP, Reactivity Lens, `pyreon check` and llms.txt together.
Only the generated reference/config.md; no guide page.
Only the generated reference/testing.md; guides/testing.md covers testing apps but not the package API in prose.
auth.md exists and reads as installable (npm install @pyreon/auth), but the package is not on npm yet: the page needs a next-release callout until it publishes.

statusLabelConflicts.note: PackageBadge status="stable". The pack rules forbid calling anything "stable"; facts.md says compat is "near-full public-API parity". The new sidebar shows no badge for them.
PackageBadge status="beta". Not one of the sidebar badge kinds; not shown.
